about: The AgileCells organisation's repositories, as code. org-apply creates any that are missing and keeps their settings as written here. It never deletes, transfers, archives or makes private (policy/abp.json). A repository with a seed is seeded with the files of its seed/ folder (only missing files are added). Every repository gives the teams in defaults.teams their permission (push, never admin).
